hypothesis: M175 shows M170 preserves robust boundary rows and passes behavior/protected-key checks while losing only a knife-edge stress row, so it needs broader split-aware evaluation against M168 before deciding the current best checkpoint.
success_criteria: compare M168 and M170 under fixed objective, full M164 replay, margin-split replay, behavior, and protected key
run additional behavior seeds beyond 9503 and 9504 for M170 and M168
keep M168 marked as strict full-replay checkpoint unless M170's knife-edge loss is explicitly accepted as stress-only
do not run more PPO during this broader evaluation
decide whether M170 becomes a split-aware candidate branch or whether M168 remains the only accepted driver checkpoint
failure_criteria: replace M168 with M170 without documenting the row67 knife-edge loss
run more PPO before broader evaluation

commands.name: m176_split_aware_m170_broader_evaluation
commands.command: Run broader non-PPO evaluation comparing M168 and M170 under strict and split-aware gates.

decision_rule: M170 can only become a split-aware candidate branch after broader behavior and gate evaluation; M168 remains the strict full-replay checkpoint until then.
